doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Back in New Orleans: Tulane band, Frankie Dusen, Zutty, Kid Rena
summary: He returns home and joins Amos Riley's Tulane band and Frankie Dusen, works Tom's Roadhouse, leads his own band, plays with Kid Rena, then returns to the boat in 1925.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Well that time it was plenty of money. Yeah, it was made up with George, George Fields, he played. And I came, I got sick, I came back home and I got back here, these fellas around here were making more money than they made in Chicago. Going up and down, right after the war then, you see. Going up and down the road to Hammond, Ponchatoula. And I joined up with Amos Riley, was in charge of the band. It was the Tulane band. And Frankie Dusen was playing in the band at the time. And I joined up and I did real well. And then we got a chance to go to Roof Garden, was played there. And then Frankie had in charge of the band, Frankie Dusen, I worked with him, I used to lead the band. And we went from the Pithin' Roof Garden to the Royal Garden in the winter, in the summer with the Pithin' Roof Garden. And after we put the top on it, well I was prepping this man there. In the meantime we had every Saturday night at Jones Country Club for a number of years. And I stayed with Frank a good while that I quit from the roof garden, a little something come up with it. And then I went to work at Tom's Roadhouse. And this boy Zutty, he's the one who gave me the job. He'd hit the drum and he had that overhead pedal and you hit it and it would bounce back a couple of times. You know, he didn't have to hang on to it. But he got to be a big time drummer after this. So when I left there, let's see what I'd do. Well I organized my own band I think. I had my Duran Humphrey and we did pretty well around there. We did pretty well around there. And so I quit my band. I quit, what did I do there? I quit, yeah that's what it is. I think I quit to go back on the boat. I don't know if I quit to go back on the boat, but I quit and I went back on the boat. I quit and I went on a regular job, that's what it was. Went on some kind of regular job, I don't know where it was now. But anyway, after that, let's see. Oh yeah, I worked with Kid Ren there. He was on a pledge for a year, not drinking. So I joined him and we did real well. And that's where I left and went back on the boat. That was in 1925. So I just went out there making, there was people so particular I knew them. Went out there just to make a nice work.
